eligibility: Independent researchers, developers and organizations contributing open software supply-chain technology or metadata.
Work must fit the call, satisfy conflict-of-interest rules and publish research/software/hardware under the required open licenses.
evidence_note: The first call page, applicant guide, eligibility page and live proposal form were reviewed together. New applicants can submit the initial proposal without a closed prior-registration stage. The November 3 noon CET deadline is already recorded on the scoped round. Access is not a personalized eligibility finding. The source GenAI policy and European-dimension requirement remain conditions.
geography: EU and Horizon Europe-associated applicants receive priority for equal proposals; exceptional applicants elsewhere require a clear European dimension.
requirements: Submit an initial proposal in English through the NLnet form and select CodeSupply.
Supply a project description, requested budget, technical approach and applicant background.
Observe the current NLnet GenAI policy; primarily AI-generated work is not eligible and permitted assistance requires disclosure.

restrictions: Initial proposal range; this is not an awarded amount or program budget.
Larger follow-on proposals have additional prior-project conditions and are outside this initial-entry record.

value.amount_text: EUR 5,000 to EUR 50,000 for an initial proposal
